configuration.candidate_selection: seeded uniform sample without replacement of 500 frozen eligible ads per user
configuration.paired_draws: same ticket26/user/opportunity uniform draw for both selected ads
configuration.retrieval: declared offline candidate pools; no FAISS or live retrieval invoked

limitations: Offline sampled synthetic outcomes, not live HTTP events or a randomized experiment.
Repeated opportunities reuse each user's selected ad and are not independent users.
Same frozen entity population and outcome assumptions as training; no unseen-population claim.
No final-test tuning, raw-score averaging, causal lift, real-user revenue or performance claim.
